mentions.name: Homemade alarm clock
mentions.description: A DIY alarm clock built from scratch, involving PCB design and modeling the case. The project aims to fill a market gap between unreliable analog alarm clocks and overpriced, ugly digital ones.
mentions.problem: The author had trouble waking up and couldn't find a suitable alarm clock: analog clocks have famously unreliable moments, and digital clocks are overpriced and ugly — a real gap in the market.
mentions.source_excerpt: I had problems waking up and was looking for an alarm clock on Amazon. But I could only find analog clocks with the famously unreliably moments, and digital clocks which were overpriced and looked ugly. This feels like a real gap in the market, so I'm working on making my own alarm clock. It's a simple enough project but includes PCB design and modelling the case, etc, which I don't have experience in.
